card.title: MASS DEPLOYMENT
card.text: Add 3 US units to your support line with total cost equal to your kredit slots.
card.flavorText: Out of the more than 16 million Americans that served in WWII, approximately 11,7 million of them served overseas. Although the United States fought many campaigns in the Pacific, Asia and North Africa, their largest military deployment was in Europe.
